description:
math-ai-bench-sources
	

This dataset contains math_ai_parallelthinking_benchmark.jsonl, built for comparing multiple reasoning trajectories across models on the same set of questions.

	
		
		File
	


math_ai_parallelthinking_benchmark.jsonl


	
		
		Data Construction
	

The benchmark is built from subsets of zechen-nlp/math-ai-bench (including gpqa) and distilled with the following 3 models:

Qwen_Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct
Qwen_Qwen3-4B-Nothinking
Qwen_Qwen3-4B-Thinking

For each model… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/haowu89/math-ai-bench-sources.
evaluation_method: accuracy (exact match of final numeric/text answer); trajectory-comparison analyses
reputation: A niche research benchmark used for comparing multiple reasoning trajectories on math problems; primarily adopted by researchers studying chain-of-thought and multi-trajectory evaluation.
